meaning:

1a) (Niphal) to strangle oneself
1b) (Piel) to strangle

elsewhere.note: When Ahithophel saw that his counsel was not followed, he saddled his donkey, arose, and went home, to his city, and set his house in order, and hanged…
The lion tore in pieces enough for his cubs, and strangled for his lionesses, and filled his caves with the kill, and his dens with prey.
